metric: Query pairs known to return different rows (the R024 sweep of an outside research assistant, the optimizer wrong-result bugs and VeriEQL's large-cardinality pairs): refuted means prove_equivalent_algebraic(..., search_counterexample=True) returned a database that, replayed on DuckDB with the optimizer off, separates the pair. R024 41/41, optimizer bugs 21/23, VeriEQL 4/4; median 0.52 s per pair.
correctness: A proof or a refutation whose database does not replay to a difference counts as wrong. Beside the score: 106/106 targeted-data escapes and 340/340 unsafe-rewrite controls refuted.
caveats: 2 pairs are not counted as refutable: their difference rests on an arbitrary DISTINCT ON pick (bug-025) or on APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT's approximation (R012b-18). bug-005 runs only on SQLite. The R024 pairs came from an outside research assistant and were re-checked on DuckDB here; they and the VeriEQL pairs were all seen while building the refuter, so only optimizer-bugs' held-out pairs are held out, and bug-001 among them prompted the replay of solver counterexamples (tuned on test).
